purpose: Prove a deterministic no-look-ahead regime-label contract on MODELLED bars

lifecycle.idea: Add regime diagnostics before comparing strategy failures by market state
lifecycle.source: Research methodology requires failure analysis by regime
lifecycle.hypothesis: Fixed rolling features can be labelled using no future bars
lifecycle.critique: No DOWN or HIGH label occurs in the modelled sample and thresholds are uncalibrated
lifecycle.decision: Accept only the causal interface; do not use labels for claims or strategy selection
lifecycle.lesson: A regime label must expose when it became available and remain separate from market truth

limitations: thresholds are not calibrated for EUR/USD
RMS log return is per-bar and not annualized volatility
liquidity, spread, sessions and external events are absent
verification: future extreme bar cannot change a prior label
synthetic tests cover UP, DOWN, RANGE, HIGH and NORMAL
lessons: Do not optimize regime thresholds against PnL
Record available_to_system_at for every derived observation
Absence of a label class in one sample is negative coverage evidence, not permission to tune
